document.title: Fire Effects Monitor or Field Observer

tasks.category: Ensure readiness for assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain and assemble information and materials needed for kit.
clarifications: Global Positioning System (GPS) with computer cable

tasks.category: Ensure readiness for assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain complete information from dispatch upon assignment.
clarifications: Authorization for use of equipment (laptops GPS, rental vehicle)

tasks.category: Ensure readiness for assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Arrive at incident and check in.
clarifications: Arrive properly equipped at assigned location within acceptable time limits.
Notify dispatch of any time delays.

tasks.category: Ensure availability, qualifications, and capabilities of resources to complete
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain appropriate work materials, supplies, and equipment to complete assignment.
clarifications: Order supplies and equipment using established procedures.

tasks.category: Gather, update, and apply situational information relevant to the assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain initial briefing from assignment supervisor.

tasks.category: Gather, update, and apply situational information relevant to the assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Review agency wildland fire procedures, policies and regulations related to position.
clarifications: Read appropriate agency manuals and handbooks.
Review recent changes in agency/interagency policies and directives related to position responsibilities.

tasks.category: Establish effective relationships with relevant personnel.
tasks.verbatim_text: Conduct self in a professional manner.
clarifications: Respectful of public and private property.

tasks.category: Establish effective relationships with relevant personnel.
tasks.verbatim_text: Establish and maintain positive interpersonal and interagency working relationships.

tasks.category: Understand and comply with ICS concepts and principles.
tasks.verbatim_text: Apply the ICS.

tasks.category: Ensure documentation is complete and disposition is appropriate.
tasks.verbatim_text: Provide monitoring summary for assigned area.
clarifications: Compare observed fire behavior and effects, with planned or anticipated effects.
Describe in narrative format how well wildland fire objectives were met.

tasks.category: Gather, produce and distribute information as required by established
tasks.verbatim_text: Recon project or assigned area and plot the project area and/or fire perimeter on a map. Review maps and overlays of reported data to ensure accuracy.
clarifications: Record geographical and topographical features (e.g., roads, fuel breaks, improvements, hazards).
Determine and record incident perimeter and identify potential changes.
Identify and map values potentially affected by fire or fire operations.

tasks.category: Gather, produce and distribute information as required by established
tasks.verbatim_text: Communicate effectively with supervisor, fire operations staff, and as appropriate, crew members and adjoining resources.
clarifications: Advise supervisor of progress and results, equipment problems, safety of assigned personnel.
Request assistance to meet monitoring or observation objectives.
Advise crew members of potential or impending safety hazards.
Inform crew members of appropriate mitigation actions (e.g., posting of lookouts, identification of safety zones and escape routes).

tasks.category: Gather, analyze, and validate information pertinent to the incident or event
tasks.verbatim_text: Review the project objectives, monitoring plan or management objectives as appropriate. Communicate concerns to supervisor.
clarifications: Components for monitoring standards, timeliness, and available resources.
Expected sampling intensity, required documentation with respect to fire behavior, and expected fire effects.
Relationship of the prescription factors, project objectives, and monitoring plan.
Relationship of the management objectives, fire effects and data collection.
Potential safety hazards as they relate to the collection of data.

tasks.category: Gather, analyze, and validate information pertinent to the incident or event
tasks.verbatim_text: Monitor, obtain, and record weather data.
clarifications: Recognize the differences among general, local and convective winds on a fire management operation.
Identify, observe and record appropriate weather data such as mid-flame wind speed, wind direction, relative humidity and other characteristics that influence fire behavior.
Document rationale for selection of suitable weather sampling site(s).

tasks.category: Gather, analyze, and validate information pertinent to the incident or event
tasks.verbatim_text: Monitor and record fire behavior data throughout the fire management operation.
clarifications: Observe and record appropriate fire behavior characteristics, such as rate of spread, flame length, residence time.
Characterize and report the range of variability of first order fire effects due to changes in fire behavior.

tasks.category: Gather, analyze, and validate information pertinent to the incident or event
tasks.verbatim_text: Monitor and record smoke management information.
clarifications: Maintain communications with the local air quality contacts, National Weather Service, weather observers, lookouts.
Identify smoke characteristics, including inversions, wind sheared columns, direction of smoke flow, and smoke impacts to sensitive sites.

tasks.category: Prepare clear and concise assessments regarding hazards, hazard behavior,
tasks.verbatim_text: Recognize and report atmospheric characteristics that influence fire behavior.
clarifications: Fire whirls, their causes, and associated fire control problems.
Winds associated with thunderstorm cells and their effect on fire behavior.
Wind speed changes and direction shifts associated with cold front passage and the effects on fire behavior.
Other indications of an unstable atmosphere.

tasks.category: Follow established procedures and/or safety procedures relevant to given
tasks.verbatim_text: Conduct monitoring and observation operations according to the Standard Fire Orders, Watch Out Situations, and LCES (Lookouts, Communications, Escape Routes, Safety Zones) principles.
clarifications: Location of established safety zones and escape routes.
Fire behavior and safety hazards which endanger personnel.

tasks.category: Plan for demobilization and ensure demobilization procedures are followed.
tasks.verbatim_text: Demobilize and check out.
clarifications: Receive demobilization instructions from incident supervisor.
If required, complete ICS 221, Demobilization Checkout and submit completed form to the appropriate person.

tasks.category: Ensure relevant information is exchanged during briefings and debriefings.
tasks.verbatim_text: Identify the roles and responsibilities of the Fire Effects Monitor on the incident.

tasks.category: Ensure documentation is complete and disposition is appropriate.
tasks.verbatim_text: Document first order fire effects related to fire treatment or management objectives and constraints.

tasks.category: Gather, analyze, and validate information pertinent to the incident or event
tasks.verbatim_text: Collect appropriate fuel, soil, and vegetation samples for moisture analysis.
clarifications: Observe and record topographic and vegetation feature influence fuel moistures (e.g., slope, aspect, shading, canopy cover, tree height).

tasks.category: Communicate and ensure understanding of work expectations within the chain
tasks.verbatim_text: Contact and coordinate with appropriate personnel.
clarifications: Contact and coordinate with Division/Group Supervisor when entering or leaving a division/group.
Validate existing products with key personnel (e.g., Geographical Information System Specialist (GISS), Operations Section Chief).

tasks.category: Transfer position duties while ensuring continuity of authority and knowledge
tasks.verbatim_text: Coordinate an efficient transfer of position duties when mobilizing/demobilizing (e.g., incoming Incident Management Team (IMT), host agency).
clarifications: Document follow-up action needed and submit to supervisor.
